fix: Make host tmux exclusivity explicit for boot-sensitive tests. Options in preference order: (a) have the integration tier acquire the SAME host-wide single-flight lock the LLM dispatch respects (bounded wait + loud degrade, mirroring acssuite's verifylock.Acquire posture) so the tier waits for a dispatch gap instead of racing it; (b) tag real-tmux tests as host-exclusive and have the per-cycle tier skip them when a live lane is dispatching, relying on CI (clean host, every PR) for that coverage — with the skip LOGGED as a named coverage gap, never silent; (c) scale boot deadlines by observed load (weakest — hides the race). Regression test: with a simulated live-dispatch holder, the tier must either wait or skip-with-log, never run the real-tmux set concurrently.
